name: CustomXMLValidationError
description: Represents a single validation error in a CustomXMLValidationErrors collection.
remarks: Validation errors can either be triggered when validating an operation against the schema, such as when adding a node, or triggered by the user when some condition is not met. For example, if a start date is later than an end date.
example:
Dim ValErrors As CustomXMLValidationErrors
Dim ValError As CustomXMLValidationError
Dim cxp1 As CustomXMLPart
Dim intError As Integer

On Error Go To validation_error

 With ActiveDocument

    ' Add and populate a custom xml part
    set cxp1 = .CustomXMLParts.Add "<invoice>"

    ' Add a node
    cxp1.AddNode "<quantity>", "supplier", "urn:invoice:namespace"

 End With

If ValErrors.Count > 0 then
   For Each ValError In ValErrors
      DeBug.Print("Error name: " & ValError.Name & " Error description: " & ValError.Text)
   Next
End If

Exit Sub

validation_error:
   CustomXMLValidationErrors.Add(ValError.Name, ValError.Text))
Resume

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLValidationError object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLValidationError object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLValidationError object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of an error in a CustomXMLValidationError object. If no errors exist, the property returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: Node
properties.description: Gets a node in a CustomXMLValidationError object, if any exist. If no nodes exist, the property returns Nothing. Read-only.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Gets the text in the CustomXMLValidationError object. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the type of error generated from the CustomXMLValidationError object. Read-only.

properties.name: ErrorCode
properties.description: Gets a number representing a validation error in a CustomXMLValidationError object. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the CustomXMLValidationError object representing a data validation error.
